info.name: Merlin
info.summary: Save and read web articles in a clean, distraction-free interface
info.description:
Merlin is a powerful read-it-later application for Nextcloud that allows you to:
* Save web articles with automatic content extraction * Read in a clean, distraction-free interface * Organize articles with tags and favorites * Export articles to HTML * Use with browser extensions (Pocket-compatible API) * Dark mode and customizable typography * Full-text search across all saved articles
Perfect for keeping track of interesting articles, research materials, or any web content you want to read later.
info.author: Julian von Bülow
